name: Writhing Crag
tactics: Unexpectedly stealthy, a writhing crag often attempts to surprise its targets. It takes a few rounds to assess the foes, then uses stone-melding slam to neutralize the most dangerous melee combatant, focusing on spellcasters and ranged attackers. It uses earth glide to gain optimal tactical position but rarely flees from battle. Most writhing crags fight to the death, believing that they cannot be defeated.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Tentacle Grab
traits.details: A writhing crag can attack and grab with up to three tentacles at a time. While grabbing an enemy, it can act normally, but it can’t use that tentacle for another attack. Enemies can attack the tentacle to make the writhing crag let go of a grabbed creature; the tentacle’s defenses are the same as the crag’s. An attack that hits a tentacle does not harm the writhing crag but causes it to let go and retract the tentacle.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.details: A writhing crag can burrow through solid stone as if it were loose earth.

hit.description: damage, and the target is grabbed

effect.description: The writhing crag makes three stone reach attacks

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: targets a creature grabbed by the writhing crag

hit.description: damage, and the writhing crag slides the target 5 squares and knocks it prone. Each enemy adjacent to the target and within the writhing crag’s reach (5 squares) takes 9 damage

powers.name: Stone-Melding Slam
powers.requirements: usable only against a target touching or adjacent to a stone surface

hit.description: damage, and the target is partly absorbed into the surface, causing it to become immobilized (save ends).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target is drawn entirely into the stone, leaving a faint imprint (no save). The target does not die but remains in stasis until it is freed from the stone

effect.description: A writhing crag that does not move and retracts its tentacles resembles a jagged rock formation, stalagmite, or stalactite. In this form, the writhing crag can be recognized only with a successful DC 35 Perception check.
